interpretation: Exploratory follow-up of inspected output-proxy results, using existing immutable sources and test pairs. Primary input encoders (fixed random projection of hidden vectors and identity on all 277 output-code features) have no data-fitted loadings. Both have 277 reconstruction inputs, identical FIT/VAL rows, centering/scaling statistics, 278-by-1024 decoder dimensions, a FIT-only 1024-by-64 probe basis, generator parameter counts and ridge search sizes. Predictions retain only each branch's own reconstructed residual, never an actual-hidden shortcut. Hidden FIT-PCA277 is a separately reported sensitivity with additional fitted input loadings; it is not an exact-budget primary comparison. Full null-space targets are primary; a shared FIT-only PCA64 target is secondary. All output features from the earlier proxy are retained. No new source training; compositions are products of separately fitted generators, not compound regressions. Ordinary calibration includes complete orbits and does not test withheld relation discovery.
